description: REQUIRED_CHECK_RECEIPTS_ARE_S1_VERIFIER_OUTPUTS_APPENDED_BY_ORG_WRITER. The NWI-S1 verifier (SV-LLM/.github#46) runs a declared check offline at the exact head and emits this receipt; it becomes a LEDGER_RECEIPT only when the org-ledger writer transition (StegVerse-Labs/.github#3255) appends it to refs/stegverse/organization-ledger under the shared lock. Validator: sv_work_items.validate_check_receipt.

change_digest.description: equals head.change_digest of the SV_CHANGE checked; otherwise CHECK_SKIPPED_OR_UNOBSERVED / RECEIPT_CHANGE_DIGEST_EQUALS_HEAD

check_id.description: one of data/sv-work-items/required-checks.json#checks (row SV-CHANGE-REQUIRED-CHECKS-001) or a stage manifest's exit_gate_check.check_id (data/sv-work-items/stages/NWI-S*.json; STAGE_GATE_RECEIPT_DERIVES_NATIVE_ISSUE); any other id is CHECK_ID_UNDECLARED

hb_epoch.description: supplied; ASCII digits, value >= 32 (org-kernel/kernel.py::supplied_epoch_failure); never from a clock

head_sha.description: the exact head commit the check ran at

verifier_ref.description: the NWI-S1 verifier run that emitted this receipt

title: SV check receipt (emitted by the NWI-S1 verifier, appended by the org-ledger writer)
